53/G.goal: Justify and apply VR navigation optimization to the Majuli virtual tour by selecting optimal or time-constrained paths that reduce cybersickness and computing routes from field-study data with TSP or VRPP solvers.
53/G.achieves: Equips the learner with a concrete XR navigation-optimization strategy for the case study and positions them for the subsequent resource-optimization part of the course.

53/O1.goal: Justify and apply VR navigation optimization to the Majuli virtual tour by selecting optimal or time-constrained paths that reduce cybersickness and computing routes from field-study data with TSP or VRPP solvers.
53/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a practical method for improving navigation and reducing cybersickness in an XR application, supporting the course aim of understanding and implementing an XR system with confidence.
